body.name: Price-breakpoint set and terminal threshold
body.construction: Enumerate every deterministic response table and every simple cycle in its comparison graph. If the cycle weight is \(A_C+B_C\kappa\), collect every nonnegative root \(-A_C/B_C\) with \(B_C\ne0\), adjoin zero, and set \(K=\max\mathcal B_{\mathrm{des}}\).
